newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Monday on short-covering after speculative selling in the previous trading session on Friday, dealers said.

The Karachi 100-share index ended 8.40 points, or 0.54 percent, up at 1,551.86. Dealer Azhar Batla of Taurus Securities attributed the rise to short-covering in speculative stocks before Tuesday's settlement day.
Hub Power Co Ltd rose 0.45 rupee to 37.80, PTCL 0.20 to 25.90 at 14.21 p.m. (0921 GMT), ICI Pakistan 0.20 to 24.65. Pakistan State Oil 6.00 to 316.
